name: Rec Plus Activity Assistant (ages 16 and up)
what_you_do: Watch over kids ages 5 to 12 at a park before and after school, and in summer. Help with crafts, outdoor play, cooking class and open gym. Help the lead staff run the day.
who_can_apply: Minimum age 16. The job post prefers a high school diploma, some college classes in child care or a close field, and 3 months of work with kids. You get CPR and First Aid within 3 months of being hired.
pay_detail: $16.45 to $19 per hour, based on school and work history. You also earn sick and safe time.
duration: 10 to 25 hours a week, Monday to Friday. School year shifts are 7 to 9:30 a.m. or 2:30 to 6 p.m. Summer hours vary.
deadline_text: Posted on the Park Board temporary jobs page in October 2026. No deadline is listed.
how_to_apply: Email your questions, resume or school transcripts to recplus@minneapolisparks.org. Say which part of Minneapolis you want to work in: North, Northeast, South or Southwest.
notes: If you get an offer, there is a background check with fingerprints. The posting does not give a closing date, so check the temporary jobs page to see if it is still listed. Minnesota work permit rules were not checked.
